description_en: After the interruption, the instance enters the suspended state
description_zh: 中断后，实例会进入中断中（suspended）状态
name: InterruptLogstashTask

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

Code.description_en: The error code. This parameter is not returned if the call is successful
Code.description_zh: 错误码 ，正常调用时，不会返回该参数

Message.description_en: The error message. This parameter is not returned if the call is successful
Message.description_zh: 错误信息，正常调用时，不会返回该参数

Result.description_en:
The returned result. Valid values:

true: The task is suspended.
false: The task failed to be suspended
Result.description_zh:
返回结果：

true：中断任务成功
false：中断任务失败
